items.title: Microsoft Entra Device Registration Authorization Bypass
items.summary: Critical CVE-2026-109469 allows unauthorized privilege escalation.
items.action: Review logs for unauthorized device registrations.

items.title: Okta Access Gateway Command Injection Vulnerability
items.summary: CVE-2026-115547 enables authenticated admins to execute system commands.

items.title: ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack Targets Microsoft 365 Tenants
items.summary: Attackers used AI agents to gain privileged access in under three hours.
items.action: Disable affected application connections and review tenant logs.

items.title: Microsoft Exchange Flaw Allows Unauthorized Mailbox Access
items.summary: CVE-2026-96940 enables attackers to read mailboxes across an organization.
items.action: Apply the latest Exchange Server security update.

items.title: CISA's 'Quality Era' Framework for CVE Program
items.summary: CISA proposes enhancements to improve CVE data resilience and accuracy.
